name: Shree Ambika Bhojanalaya
area: Walking distance from Ambaji Temple, towards ST Bus Station
why_it_matters: The Shri Arasuri Ambaji Mata Devasthan Trust's own bhojanalaya — full thali coupon ~₹165 (children ₹115, with-sweet ₹215), unlimited refills, dedicated 1st-floor dining hall. The safest, cleanest, cheapest meal in Ambaji and the default pilgrim address during Navratri when commercial restaurants overflow.
insider_tip: Buy the coupon at the ground-floor counter BEFORE going up to the 1st-floor dining hall — they won't seat you without one. Open 10 AM-10 PM with no afternoon break. Cash + UPI accepted.
signature_address: Shree Ambika Bhojanalaya (Trust-run), near Ambaji Temple, towards ST Bus Station, Ambaji, Banaskantha 385110

name: Manglam Dining Hall
why_it_matters: Rated 4.2/5 across 443+ reviews on Justdial — directly opposite Ambaji Temple on the SH-54 road, opposite the Ambika Bhojanalaya. The default commercial mid-range thali address with AC seating, faster service, and a Punjabi alternative when you want a break from satvik temple food.
insider_tip: Pair logic: trust bhojanalaya for one meal of the day, Manglam for the other when you want AC + variety. Faster turnover than the trust, lines move quicker at peak.
signature_address: Manglam Dining Hall, GJ SH 54, Arsuri Society, opposite Ambaji Temple and Ambika Bhojanalaya, Ambaji, Banaskantha 385110

name: Royal Zayka Restaurant
signature_dish: Unlimited Gujarati thali — 2 sweets, 4 sabji, 2 farsan, papad
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor 4.0/5 + Justdial 4.2/5 (458+ reviews) — pitched as the pilgrim-circuit value pick with a documented unlimited thali (2 sweets, 4 sabji, 2 farsan, papad, buttermilk). The default DK Circle / SBI-side option for travellers staying outside the immediate temple cluster.
insider_tip: Opens 8 AM — earlier than most Ambaji restaurants — so it's the breakfast option for the 7.30 AM aarti crowd. Punjabi 'fix' menu is consistently better-reviewed than Chinese.
signature_address: DK Circle, near SBI, Ambaji, Banaskantha 385110

name: Gormeh Thaal (Hotel Ambaji International)
area: Himmatnagar Highway, near Ambaji Temple + Bus Stop
why_it_matters: Hotel Ambaji International's in-house vegetarian restaurant — sits on the Himmatnagar Highway approach to Ambaji, near both the temple and the bus stop. Mid-range hotel restaurant for travellers who want a step up from the dharmshala food without going fine-dine.
insider_tip: Best for an arrival lunch or pre-departure dinner when you've just checked in/out of the hotel — table-service pace, no coupon queue. Booking gives priority during Navratri rush.
signature_address: Hotel Ambaji International, Himmatnagar Highway, near Ambaji Temple + Bus Stop, Ambaji, Banaskantha 385110
